name: My Aged Care help at home and CHSP
description: Entry-level help at home through My Aged Care, including personal care, nursing care, meals, domestic assistance, allied health, equipment and assessment pathways.
care_team_notes: Use for people generally aged 65+ or Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people aged 50+. Ask age and location before choosing My Aged Care versus NDIS.

name: Support at Home personal care
description: Support at Home personal care services including showering, continence support, dressing, eating, hygiene and assistance with self-administration of medication.
care_team_notes: Use exact dates for contribution changes. From 1 October 2026, approved personal care under Support at Home is fully government funded if assessed and funds are available.

name: NDIS assistance with daily life
description: NDIS home and living guidance on assistance with daily life, personal care, cooking, cleaning, laundry, support workers, home modifications, SIL, ILO and other home options.
care_team_notes: Use for people under 65 or existing NDIS participants. Separate disability-related supports from ordinary rent, groceries, bills and daily living costs.

name: NDIS disability-related health supports
description: NDIS guidance on disability-related health supports such as nursing or qualified therapist support, training for supporters, continence products, dressings, PEG-related food products, pressure care cushions and cough assist equipment.
care_team_notes: Cross-reference food/nutrition, breathing, pressure care and equipment topics. Do not treat NDIS as replacing state health responsibilities.

name: Support workers and personal care routines
description: NDIS information on support workers, including household support, personal care, hygiene, dressing, medication help, registered/unregistered workers and goal-related support.
care_team_notes: Encourage written routines and preferences for MND care, especially transfers, communication, swallowing safety, fatigue, privacy and emergency escalation.

name: SIL, ILO and higher-intensity home support
description: NDIS information on supported independent living, individualised living options, overnight support and when higher-intensity support worker arrangements may be considered.
care_team_notes: MND needs can change quickly. Suggest review when overnight needs, transfers, ventilation, toileting or carer strain change.

name: Planned and emergency respite
description: Carer Gateway information on planned respite and emergency respite when a carer needs a break or cannot continue caring because of illness or injury.
care_team_notes: For emergency backup, link to Topic 15 emergency planning and encourage a written care plan with medicines, communication, transfers, feeding and breathing needs.

name: Complaints, safeguards and consumer protections
publisher: NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission / Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission
description: Information on raising concerns about NDIS providers/workers, aged care Support at Home protections, safety, quality, pricing transparency and complaint pathways.
care_team_notes: If there is harm, neglect, abuse or serious risk, advise urgent escalation through appropriate emergency/safeguarding channels and the relevant commission.

name: Changing in-home services as needs change
description: Guidance on reviewing care plans and adding/changing services when needs change, including provider discussions, reassessment pathways and budget/service-management issues.
care_team_notes: For MND, prompt earlier review because functional, swallowing, respiratory and carer capacity can change faster than annual review cycles.
